title: Newton's law of gravitation and field strength; Friction
source: Questions copied unchanged from the mission-lesson scripts for AP Physics C: Mechanics (status of the source: mission-lesson scripts of Oct-Nov 2026 (reviewed by AI reviewers; not signed off by a person)). Terms and clues: C03-1#t1 term and clue written for the game; C03-1#t4 term and clue written for the game; C03-1#t2 term and clue written for the game; D05-1#t1 term and clue written for the game. Questions: C03-1#N.3, D05-1#N.7b, C03-1#N.8b, D05-1#N.11a, C03-1#N.12.

assemble.prompt: Match each term to its definition.

items.label: Gravitational field strength
items.clue: Force per unit mass on a small test mass, in N kg⁻¹.

items.label: Uniform field
items.clue: Model used near the surface, where g barely changes.

items.label: Inverse-square law
items.clue: Pattern in which doubling r divides the pull by four.

items.label: Friction
items.clue: Acts parallel to two touching surfaces, opposing slipping between them.

questions.stem: Two objects exert gravitational forces of magnitude F on each other. The mass of each object is doubled, and the distance between their centres is tripled. What is the new magnitude of the gravitational force that each object exerts on the other?

A 0.80 kg box rests on a level floor. The coefficients of friction between the box and the floor are μ_s = 0.60 and μ_k = 0.35. A student pushes the box horizontally, increasing the push slowly from zero. Use g = 10 m/s². What is the magnitude of the push when the box starts to slide?
An astronaut's weight at Earth's surface is W. Planet Q has three times Earth's mass and twice Earth's radius. What is the astronaut's weight at the surface of planet Q?

A book lies on the flat bed of a pickup truck. The truck speeds up from rest along a straight, level road, and the book does not slide on the bed. Which statement about friction on the book is correct?

options.text: Friction pushes the book backward, opposite to its motion.
No friction acts, since the book does not slide on the bed.
Kinetic friction from the bed pushes the book forward, as the book moves along the road.
Static friction from the bed pushes the book forward.

questions.stem: Planets A and B are uniform spheres with the same density. Planet A has radius R and planet B has radius 2R. Identical probes are placed in shafts inside the planets, each at a distance R/2 from its planet's center. F_A and F_B are the magnitudes of the gravitational forces exerted on the probes by their planets. Which is correct?
